failure_summary.description: Over-specification of full names (First Last) when the gold standard or context expects only the surname/core identifier.

patch.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the target entity but incorrectly expanded it to a full name ('Wesley Clark') instead of the expected surname ('Clark'). This reflects a recurring pattern of over-specification in trivia contexts where surname-only answers are standard. The added rule explicitly enforces surname preference for persons to align with gold standards and minimize unnecessary name components.

edits.content: - **Surname-Only Preference for Persons**: In trivia and Jeopardy-style contexts, default to returning only the surname for persons (e.g., 'Clark' not 'Wesley Clark'). Only include first/middle names if explicitly requested by the question or required to resolve ambiguity among multiple candidates with the same surname.
